caseName: United States ex rel. Lee Kum Hoy v. Shaughnessy
caseNameFull: United States ex rel. Lee Kum Hoy v. Shaughnessy, District Director, Immigration and Naturalization Service
attorneys: Edward J. Ennis for Lee Moon Wah, petitioner. Solicitor General Rankin, Assistant Attorney General Olney, Beatrice Rosenberg and Carl H. Imlay for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit granted, limited to the question of whether there was unconstitutional discrimination against petitioners by the use of blood tests in determination of their application for entry to this country.
